description:
This is a  Sources Sought notice  issued for market research and planning purposes only. The Government is seeking information from interested and capable sources that can perform selective interior demolition, electrical and architectural restoration, and associated facility repairs at Offutt Air Force Base, Nebraska. 

 This notice is  not  a solicitation, request for quotation, request for proposal, or invitation for bid. It does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation, award a contract, or reimburse any respondent for costs associated with preparation or submission of a response. Responses will be used solely to assess market capability and inform acquisition planning, including potential small-business participation or set-aside considerations.
